title: GoTo Financial - Lending Risk Analyst Acceleration Program
job_description:
About the job

About The Role

GoTo Financial is seeking ambitious talents to join our Lending Risk Analyst Acceleration Program. This is not just a job, it is a structured rotational program designed to build the next generation of risk leaders in the digital finance space—offering a faster track to career progression for high-potential individuals.

As a trainee, you will embark on a hands-on on-the-job learning journey, rotating through specialized functions within our Lending Risk division. You will gain deep expertise in identifying, assessing, and mitigating the most critical risks in our financial ecosystems. By working alongside industry experts, you will learn how to balance innovation with prudence while accelerating your professional growth in one of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing fintech environments.

Your work will help reshaping the future of thelending industry. If you’re excited about the challenge, this role is for you!”

What You Will Do


Risk Analytics & Insights: Leverage large datasets to extract actionable insights, identify emerging risk trends, monitor portfolio performance, and support the development of data-driven risk strategies across credit and fraud domains.
Rotational Exposure: Participate in structured rotations across different functions within Credit Risk and Fraud Risk to understand the end-to-end risk management lifecycle.
Risk Monitoring: Support the team in daily risk monitoring activities, including tracking key risk indicators (KRIs) and generating regular risk reports for stakeholders.
Policy & Process Improvement: Collaborate with team leads to review and enhance risk policies, standard operating procedures, and internal controls to ensure they remain robust and scalable.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with STLs, Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure risk considerations are integrated into new product launches and features.
Project Support: Contribute to special projects and initiatives aimed at modernizing the risk management framework, including the exploration of new tools or methodologies.


What You Will Need:


Educational Background: Fresh graduate or recent graduate (graduated within the last 2 years) with a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a reputable university.
Field of Study: Strong academic track record in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or other related quantitative fields.
Data Proficiency: Analytical skills with hands-on experience in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Python, or R) is highly preferred.
Problem-Solving Mindset: Logical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a passion for data analysis and tackling complex challenges.
Adaptability: Eagerness to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges in a fast-paced, ever-changing fintech landscape.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to articulate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Attitude: Highly motivated, detail-oriented, and possessing a strong sense of integrity and ownership.


About The Team

You will be part of the GoPay Lending Risk Team, responsible for supporting the risk management of our lending products. The team plays a key role in ensuring that our lending business grows sustainably while maintaining strong risk control.

The team focuses on identifying, assessing, and managing credit and operational risks across the lending lifecycle, including risk strategy, policy development, monitoring portfolio performance, and implementing risk mitigation measures.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Data, Engineering, and Business teams, and collaborate with stakeholders across different regions. This provides an opportunity to contribute to impactful initiatives while gaining exposure to a dynamic and fast-growing fintech environment.

About GoTo Group

GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.

The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek

Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial

GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

A place to make a difference:

This isn't a conventional quality role. The Program Quality Lead exists to change how programs run. Not by reviewing from the sidelines, but by getting into the architecture of delivery and making it work better. If you're the kind of person who sees a broken logframe and fixes it rather than just flagging it, who challenges weak assumptions rather than letting them pass, and who thinks the INGO sector's quality systems need rethinking, read on.

 

This role is part of a new operating model that separates upstream design from downstream quality and delivery. You'll be one of two Program Quality Leads providing holistic technical support across a portfolio of donor-funded programs in the Asia-Pacific region. The model is built around clear ownership, coordinated quality, and genuine Country Office partnership. This role is central to making it work.

 

In this full-time, permanent role, you'll work as part of our International Programs team, contributing to our commitment to children. You'll be based ideally in Australia or Asia-Pacific time zones, though other locations will be considered. You will work predominantly from home.

 

You will make a difference by:

· Providing early, consolidated quality assurance that prevents rework, not adding another review loop

· Translating monitoring data into specific, implementable changes to programs, not writing reports about what the data shows

· Challenging weak assumptions, default practices, and checkbox inclusion when they undermine delivery or credibility

· Building results frameworks and indicators that are measurable, realistic, and defensible under donor scrutiny

· Working as a high-trust critical friend to Country Office teams: bringing technical depth to the problems they bring you, practical in your advice, outcome-oriented in your approach, and willing to hold the line on standards while building CO capability over time

· Using AI tools to increase speed and consistency in structured quality work, with strong human judgment and governance

 

A place to feel valued:

You take an entrepreneurial approach. You propose improvements, test them quickly, scale what works, and retire what doesn't. You understand the financial math of international development and you know that quality isn't just about standards. It's about making programs competitive, fundable, and deliverable.

 

This role requires:

· Demonstrated technical depth in at least one thematic area relevant to SCA's portfolio (e.g. education, child protection, health, nutrition, WASH, livelihoods, climate adaptation), with the ability to apply that depth across a broader quality and monitoring remit

· Demonstrated breadth across program quality, monitoring/results, and inclusion, with evidence of improving delivery in complex operating environments

· Proven ability to translate evidence and performance signals into implementable changes to results frameworks/logframes, workplans/DIPs, reporting products, and budget sequencing

· Strong analytical capability: structured data review, pattern recognition, and practical implications for delivery decisions

Large-scale language models are rapidly advancing, and their ability to handle rigorous proof-based reasoning depends on high-quality mathematical training data. That training data begins with you - your insight will help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for specialists with deep foundations in pure mathematics who can engage with advanced topics across probability theory, measure theory, real and functional analysis, optimization, abstract algebra, and category theory. Clear, metacognitive communication (explicitly articulating reasoning and proof strategies) is essential.

Require remediation, retraining, or rollback where models fail to meet defined thresholds

Strong understanding of end-to-end AI/ML model development lifecycle, including problem framing, data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring

Experience with model performance metrics, stress testing, and robustness testing

About the job

You won't write code. You'll build the agents that do.




At Novo AI, engineers don't type syntax — they orchestrate. Claude and Cursor generate 100% of our production code. Your job isn't to write functions. It's to architect systems, design evaluations, and manage fleets of AI agents that ship themselves.




If you want to show off your LeetCode skills or hand-craft boilerplate, this isn't for you. If you want to push the boundary of what's possible when a human directs AI at full throttle — keep reading.




What you'll actually build




Self-improving agent pipelines. You'll design multi-step workflows where AI agents extract structured data from messy, real-world medical documents — invoices, hospital records, pre-authorization requests. You set the spec. The agents iterate. You evaluate, adjust, and ship.




Agents that run production for you. No more ugly stacktraces at 2 AM. The production agents you build will watch themselves, detect anomalies, and ping you with a well-formed problem statement — not a raw error log. They might even roll back a bad deploy before you wake up.




Business intelligence at scale. Extracting data is step one. The real work is building agents that self-plan — querying structured databases, forming hypotheses, and surfacing answers autonomously. Why is medical inflation running 15% year-over-year? Where is the money going? Your agents will find out.




Why this matters




Insurance companies control the largest flow of money in healthcare. Every claim decision shapes which doctors thrive, which treatments get adopted, and which patients get care. That makes insurers the single highest-leverage point for improving healthcare outcomes — and most of them still run on manual processes and outdated systems. We're changing that.




We've already proven this works. We serve insurance clients across Singapore, Thailand, and France — reducing manual processing by 80% with AI. Real documents. Real production. Real impact on how healthcare money flows.




Now we're scaling across the insurance landscape. We turn unstructured medical documents into structured data, then deploy agents that provide real business intelligence — surfacing where costs are exploding, where fraud hides, and where better decisions can save both money and lives.




Who you'll work with




Founded by ex-Google engineers and built by top-tier ITB alumni. We value rigor, speed, and the ability to think in systems.




Your arsenal




We don't hamstring our engineers. You get:




Claude Max ($200/mo plans) — no token anxiety

We need someone to own data. Not manage a team that does data. Own it — from finding the right sources, to getting them flowing, to making sure they stay healthy at scale.

Build tooling that makes adding the next data source faster than the last one

---




MASALAH NYATA YANG HARUS KAMU SELESAIKAN




Kami punya 300+ smart vending machines aktif di seluruh Indonesia. Ratusan entrepreneur yang jadi klien. Tapi cara kita dapat leads baru sampai hari ini? Masih manual. Masih 1-on-1. Masih bergantung pada orang

Kalau kamu tipe yang lebih puas melihat workflow automation berjalan mulus daripada viral post, keep reading.

PERAN INI: APA YANG SEBENARNYA KAMU KERJAKAN




1. Bangun Lead Generation Engine

Tugas utama: sistem kita harus bisa dapat 50+ qualified leads per minggu—tanpa manusia yang aktif mengejar satu per satu.

Funnel: LinkedIn outreach → CRM entry → Email nurture → WhatsApp follow-up (all automated)

Integration layer: connect tools yang kita pakai (HubSpot/Notion, WhatsApp Business API, Make/n8n) jadi satu ekosistem

2. AI-Powered Content & Outreach




Bukan sekadar pakai ChatGPT untuk nulis caption. Kita bicara tentang:

Bangun content pipeline pakai AI: landing page, email sequences, LinkedIn outreach, SMS blast — semua bisa di-deploy sales dalam 10 detik
Personalisasi massal: pesan yang terasa personal untuk setiap segmen (F&B brand, retail chain, MSME owner) tapi dihasilkan sistem
SEO + edukasi market: artikel yang menjawab pertanyaan "apa itu vending machine bisnis?" sebelum prospect bahkan sadar mereka butuh kita

Success metric Bulan 6: Open rate email 65%+, reply rate 12%+.




3. Growth Dashboard & Intelligence




Saat ini data kita tersebar: Google Sheets, CRM terpisah, laporan manual. Kamu akan:

Konsolidasi semua data ke satu dashboard (leads, conversion rate, CAC, LTV, pipeline)
Buat weekly report yang menjawab: "Dari mana leads terbaik datang? Apa yang mati? Apa yang harus di-double down?"
Ubah keputusan tim dari gut feeling jadi data-driven

Success metric Bulan 6: Leadership dan sales pakai dashboard ini setiap hari—bukan sekadar pajangan.




---

Yang kamu bawa:




Proven experience dengan marketing automation platform (Make, n8n, Zapier, HubSpot, atau equivalent)
Comfortable dengan API logic: webhooks, triggers, conditional workflows—bukan coding, tapi harus natural
CRM architecture: paham custom fields, pipeline stages, data hygiene
AI tools untuk business (bukan cuma copywriting)
Bisa baca + interpret data: conversion rate, CAC, LTV, payback period




Nice to have:

WhatsApp Business API integration experience
Basic SEO (keyword research, on-page)
E-commerce funnel (Shopify, WooCommerce)




---




GET IT / WANT IT / CAPABLE




Get It:

Kamu paham Smartven bukan jual mesin—kami jual business enablement. Setiap leads yang datang adalah calon entrepreneur yang butuh kepastian, edukasi, dan trust sebelum commit. Sistem yang kamu bangun harus terasa personal dan manusiawi, bukan spammy.




Want It:

Kamu frustrasi dengan marketing yang manual, lambat, dan tidak scalable. Kamu ingin build once, run forever. Kamu excited lebih lihat workflow berjalan otomatis daripada dapat pujian atas satu campaign.




Capable:




2+ tahun di growth marketing, marketing ops, atau B2B growth (SaaS, marketplace, atau e-commerce)
Punya track record: bukan "pernah pakai Zapier" tapi "saya bangun sistem X yang generate Y leads per bulan"
Nyaman kerja lintas fungsi: ngobrol teknikal dengan CTO, kasih brief ke sales, report ke CEO
Data-literate: kamu baca angka untuk buat keputusan, bukan validasi opini




---




SCORECARD + PROBATION (3 Bulan Pertama)




Bulan 1 — Audit & Quick Wins (No pressure)

Pelajari semua lead gen sources yang ada sekarang
Audit gaps: mana yang manual, mana yang bisa diautomasi
Deliver: 2 quick wins yang bisa langsung impact pipeline




Bulan 2–3 — Build & Prove

Build end-to-end funnel pertama: LinkedIn → CRM → Email nurture sequence
Target: 20+ qualified leads/minggu dari sistem
Build draft growth dashboard




Kalau kamu hit targets: Full contract + salary review

Kalau tidak: Percakapan jujur—ada opsi pivot ke role lain, atau exit dengan severance

Yang pasti: Kamu dapat feedback setiap minggu. Tidak ada kejutan di bulan ke-3.




---




KOMPENSASI

Base Salary: IDR 8M–12M/bulan (depends on track record)

Performance Bonus (per kuartal):

Sistem generate 50+ leads/minggu → +IDR 2M–4M
Email open rate 65%+ → +IDR 1M–2M
Dashboard dipakai aktif tim → +IDR 1M–2M

Total potential Tahun 1: IDR 10M–15M/bulan rata-rata

Tahun 2+: Head of Growth — salary naik + equity conversation terbuka




Culture: Flat hierarchy. Feedback mingguan. Bukan perusahaan besar—kamu ownership atas pekerjaan kamu, bukan sekadar executioner brief dari atasan.




---




HONEST EXPECTATIONS




Data kita saat ini berantakan. Kamu akan spend waktu di data cleaning sebelum bisa mulai analisis.
Pasar Indonesia masih edukasi. Sebagian prospect belum pernah dengar "marketing automation"—sistem kamu harus bridge gap itu.
Funnel pertama mungkin tidak langsung berhasil. Iterasi adalah bagian dari pekerjaan.
Kita bergerak cepat. Prioritas bisa berubah tiap minggu berdasarkan feedback pasar.
Ini bukan role Fortune 500. Tidak ada marketing department besar, tidak ada agency support. Kamu adalah sistemnya.




---

CARA APPLY (Kami Filter Action-Takers)

Kami tidak minta resume dulu. Kami minta bukti kamu bisa kerja.




Kamu akan diminta Kirim 2 hal ini bila shortlisted:

1. Voice note 3 menit (rekam lewat HP):

Perkenalan singkat: nama, background, terbesar yang pernah kamu build
Jawab: Kenapa Smartven? Kenapa sekarang?

2. Satu paragraf (tulisan):

Describe 1 automation funnel yang pernah kamu bangun: tools yang dipakai, masalah yang dipecahkan, dan hasilnya dalam angka




Kenapa dua hal ini? Voice note menunjukkan energy dan komunikasi. Paragraf tulisan membuktikan kamu bisa think sistematis dan ukur hasil—bukan cuma bicara tentang marketing.




Timeline: Kami putuskan maximum dalam 1 minggu ini. Lamar Senin → keputusan Jumat.




---

APPLY KALAU:

Punya 2+ funnels yang proven generate leads (bukan sekadar "pernah setup Zapier")
Excited bangun sistem yang scalable dari 300 ke 10.000 klien
Suka ambiguity—dan solve it dengan data, bukan asumsi
Ingin ownership penuh, bukan sekadar eksekusi brief




JANGAN APPLY KALAU:

Butuh struktur marketing department yang established
Prefer perfect data sebelum buat keputusan
Tidak nyaman dengan feedback mingguan
Kamu think "good marketing" = konten yang aesthetically pleasing




Ready?

Kami excited ketemu builder yang serius.

title: AIPDRM - Full Stack Developer IT Specialist - Disaster Knowledge Management System (DKMS) BNPB
job_description:
About the job

AIPDRM - Full Stack Developer IT Specialist 

 Disaster Knowledge Management System (DKMS) BNPB 

Program Overview

The Australia-Indonesia Partnership in Disaster Risk Management (SIAP SIAGA) is a seven-year program that commenced in late 2019, funded by the Australian Government’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and implemented in cooperation with the Government of Indonesia (GoI). SIAP SIAGA aims at improving Indonesia’s ability to prevent, prepare for, respond to and recover from disasters and strengthen cooperation between Australia and Indonesia in humanitarian issues in the region. SIAP SIAGA is implemented at the national and sub-national levels though collaboration with the National Disaster Management Authority (BNPB), the Ministry of Home Affairs, the National Development Planning Agency (BAPPENAS), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Local Disaster Management Agencies (BPBD) and other national and local government institutions, civil society organizations and academia.

SIAP SIAGA is focused on achieving four ends of program outcomes (EOPOs):


 EOPO 1: GoI’s disaster risk reduction systems are strengthened, resulting in better domestic leadership of disaster management.
 EOPO 2: Target provinces, districts and villages are better able to prepare for, adapt, prevent, respond to and recover from disasters.
 EOPO 3: Strengthened cooperation between Australia and Indonesia on disaster risk management and preparedness regionally.
 EOPO 4: Strengthened learning, innovation, cooperation and inclusion for disaster management.


It is progressing towards these outcomes by focusing on eight priority programs of the GoI: (1) enhancement of disaster management systems; (2) enhancement of disaster management strategy; (3) mapping and evaluation of disaster risks; (4) enhancement of data service, information management, and communication in disaster management; (5) enhancement and development of policies and regulations for disaster preparedness; (6) increasing the quality of disaster emergency management; (7) enhancement of the quality of post disaster policy; and (8) increasing local capacity of disaster management logistics and equipment.

To strengthen the disaster management system, SIAP SIAGA provides strategic technical advice to align national and local policies with international commitments. This effort focuses on embedding gender mainstreaming, institutionalizing disability inclusion, and supporting climate change adaptation across disaster risk reduction, preparedness, response, and recovery processes, through collaboration with national and local partners.

At the sub-national level, SIAP SIAGA works with four provinces in Indonesia: East Java, Bali, West Nusa Tenggara, and East Nusa Tenggara. It also promotes disaster management initiatives and innovations through its outreach program to up to six other provinces.

Purpose Of The Position

Under the direction of national program lead, The IT Fullstack Developer Specialist for Disaster Knowledge Management System (DKMS) BNPB will provide technical support for maintenance, refinement and addition of knowledge documents through the DKMS platform and updating the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030 at BNPB. The Developer specialist will perform the following tasks:


 Improving features/functions of DKMS - BNPB to enhance BNPB’s role in assisting the regions in disaster management in Indonesia and abroad through disaster literacy.
 Supporting the development of DKMS from the front-end and back-end in line with the development of the Artificial Intelligence ecosystem so that DKMS will remain relevant to meet user’s needs.
 Supporting the integration of knowledge and the results from SIAP SIAGA program that can be used widely by various stakeholders to improve coordination, monitoring, and decision-making from ministries/agencies through better data management.
 Updating the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030with the latest developments and projected needs of utilization of Artificial Intelligence until 2030 to make it remain relevant.
 The consultant will coordinate the resulting product with relevant ministries/agencies and support the institutionalization and sustainable integration of the platform into disaster data and information systems.


Role And Responsibilities

The Developer specialist - DKMS BNPB below Program National Lead - will do the following things:


 Conducting an analysis of the DKMS system architecture to determine the strengths and weaknesses of the platform, including website structure, server and network stability, and AI performance.
 Maintaining the DKMS website back-end on the website Content Management System (CMS) as the main portal in managing knowledge assets and data collected in the DKMS repository so that it will operate optimally.
 Maintaining the DKMS website’s front-end to make it easier for users, especially local governments and the public, to access and contribute to the repository.
 Configure the use and updates of Google Gemini as the main AI engine of used in DKMS to operate optimally.
 Updating the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030 in accordance with the latest AI technology developments and projected AI development and specific hardware and software needed for DKMS optimization.


Expected Key Results

Working under the direction of the National Program Lead, the Developer - DKMS BNPB will produce the following Results:


 The DKMS platform runs smoothly in terms of website performance, ease of access, server stability, and AI performance for document search and summary features.
 The optimal performance of the DKMS CMS makes it easier for enumerators and users to add assets and knowledge data to enrich the repository.
 Google Gemini service is running for the DKMS website so that the search and document summary features continue to run optimally.
 The preparation of the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030 is in accordance with AI developments and projections of AI progress for the next 4 years.


Duration and location:

It is estimated that the total input will take up to 90 days, from 1 May to 31 October 2026 and the work will be at BNPB Office.

Key Relationships

This position will work closely with the following individual and/or organisation:


 Working under the supervision of PIC Program Activity 1.1.1 and National Program Lead.
 Weekly report/monthly to Senior Disaster Analyst from the Directorate of Disaster Management System, BNPB and National Program Lead.
 Consult with PIC DKMS and Associate Disaster Analyst from the Directorate of Disaster Management Systems of BNPB, and other related ministries/institutions; and
 Coordinate with other SIAP SIAGA team members as needed, particularly with KPL, Communications, and Operations for product integration purposes/knowledge.
 Coordinate with enumerator as well as the DKMS CMS team in operationalizing the DKMS CMS.


Qualifications, Experience And Personal Attributes


 Bachelor’s degree in information systems or other related discipline.
 Minimum of 10 years’ experience in the field of Information Technology.
 Experience in managerial positions.
 Ability to work with a team and manage projects.
 Understand the concept of Information Technology (IT) technically and theoretically.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Engineering department oversees all Agoda’s ML and software related requirements. Our goal is to enable and increase Agoda’s business through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, ML driven solutions, queue systems and data monitoring tools. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the engineering team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the ML engineering squad, but also the reward. We work across structured and non-structured data at scale. For example, our current ML models process millions of images every day to try and enhance the experience that our users get from our app.

Why Agoda Engineering Team (ML role)?

Our engineering teams are at the intersection of business analytics, ml engineering, data warehousing and software engineering. Our job involves dealing with distributed systems, stream processing, ml modeling and computation at tens of PB Scale. We focus on software engineering related to data replication, storage, centralized computation, and Data API’s. By providing our users with ML products/tools, shared frameworks, and ML services, we enable our company to validate strategic decisions, make smarter choices, and react to the fast-changing world. We are a small but passionate team with people from different nationalities working together on a single goal.

In this Role, you will get to:


Lead the team technically in improving scalability, stability, accuracy, speed and efficiency of our existing ML systems and processes. Build, administer and scale ML processing pipelines.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science /information systems/engineering/related field 6+ years of experience in software engineering with a minimum of 4+ years in ML
Expert in SQL, Python3, and JVM based programming language – ie, Java or Scala
Expert in software design/design patterns, functional programming and object-oriented programming.

Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystems and Big Data architecture and techologies

About the job

Proactively and systematically test device locking mechanism on a diverse range of Android devices and OS versions following every OTA update.

title: AI Engineer
job_description:
About the job

AI Engineer — Model Training & AI Exploration

About The Project

We are building a comprehensive Quran Recitation Learning Platform — a production system that helps users practice and improve their Quran recitation using real-time AI-powered speech recognition, Tajweed rule analysis, and personalized audio feedback. The platform consists of a React Native mobile app, a FastAPI backend, and multiple GPU-accelerated microservices.

Our AI pipeline currently processes thousands of audio recordings, combining ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition), Tajweed analysis, pronunciation validation, and TTS (Text-to-Speech) feedback generation — all running as containerized gRPC microservices with CUDA acceleration.

Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Engineer to own and advance the model training pipeline and explore new AI approaches to improve our Quran recitation system. You will work with production ASR models and Tajweed analysis — improving accuracy, reducing latency, and expanding capabilities.

This is a hands-on role focused on fine-tuning, evaluation, improve scoring and AI R&D — not just API integration. You will be the primary person responsible for making AI models and scoring better.

What You'll Do

Scoring Improvement


Use method for improve tajweed and word error calculation
Create script for harness test


Model Training & Fine-Tuning


Fine-tune ASR models for Quranic Arabic using NVIDIA NeMo (FastConformer Hybrid RNNT/CTC architecture)
Train and optimize custom models for Tajweed rule detection (currently Whisper-based)
Train pronunciation validation models using Wav2Vec2 for harakat (diacritics) error detection
Build and maintain training data pipelines — data collection, cleaning, augmentation, and quality control
Develop evaluation harnesses with automated metrics (WER, CER, Tajweed accuracy, speaker similarity)
Manage experiment tracking (MLflow / Weights & Biases) and model versioning


AI Exploration & R&D


Research and prototype new architectures for Quranic Arabic ASR (conformer variants, whisper fine-tuning, custom tokenizers)
Explore on-device / edge deployment of lightweight ASR models for mobile inference
Experiment with LLM-based approaches for contextual recitation feedback and error explanation
Benchmark alternative models (e.g., Whisper large-v3, SeamlessM4T, custom conformer) against current pipeline
Research voice activity detection (VAD) and audio segmentation optimized for Quranic recitation patterns


Current System You'll Improve

Our AI Pipeline Today

Mobile App (React Native)

↓ Audio (WAV 16kHz)

Backend (FastAPI + Socket.IO)

↓ gRPC

├── QuranASRNemo (port 50051) -- NeMo FastConformer, streaming + offline

├── QuranASRTajweed (port 50053) -- Whisper-based Tajweed rule detection

├── QuranASRWav2Vec2 (port 50054) -- Raw pronunciation validation

└── QuranFeedback (port 50052) -- Coqui XTTS v2 TTS with voice cloning ## Disabled for now

↓

Weighted Scoring → Accuracy + Tajweed Violations + Pronunciation Errors ## This need to be improve

↓

Audio Feedback (TTS) + Text Feedback → Mobile App ## Disabled for now

Known Areas For Improvement You'd Tackle


Hardcoded confidence scores (currently fixed at 0.9 regardless of actual model output)
GPU inference serialization bottleneck (single lock, no batching)
No model versioning or experiment tracking infrastructure
Scoring thresholds lack empirical calibration (current heuristic: 45/25/15/15 split)
TTS voice cloning path bug (hardcoded speaker reference)
No training data pipeline or data quality tooling exists yet


Notes

Model training and fine tune is not primary focus for now, but nice to do if wanted

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We work from the very lowest levels of the Linux system - BIOS and boot loaders, firmware, kernel and drivers, all the way up to desktop applications and containers. We work on tiny devices like the Raspberry Pi and new RISC-V boards, all the way up to supercomputers, clouds and Kubernetes clusters. We work on compilers and toolchains, and we work on security, cryptography, performance and documentation. Some of our teams focus on packaging thousands of pieces of software, others focus on deep contributions to a single body of code.

If you are excited about the potential that open source has for humanity and the enterprise, you have outstanding results in your academic career, and you are excited to contribute to the open source stack, this is the best way to apply to Canonical. We will work with you to identify teams and projects that would be interesting and a good fit for your skills and motivations. The process is highly competitive, it will require effort and excellence to succeed if you apply here.

job_description:
About the job

About Naluri

We are a digital health therapeutics company operating across SEA, focused on the intersection of mental health and physical chronic diseases. We combine behavioural science, psychology, data science and digital design to help companies, healthcare providers, and ultimately, people on achieving a healthier lifestyle.

Position: AI Engineer

The Role

At Naluri, we use technology to make holistic health accessible, and we need your help to take our platforms to the next level. For this role, we aren't looking for an AI researcher to train foundational models from scratch; we are looking for a passionate Builder.




Your mission will be to bring the magic of the world's best Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) directly into our members' health journeys. You will be the bridge between cutting-edge AI and real-world human impact, building scalable backend APIs and ensuring our AI products are fast, safe, and reliable.




At Naluri, you will truly own the end-to-end lifecycle of our AI features. From creative prompt engineering and seamless third-party API integration, to smart database design and cloud deployment—you’ll be building the tools that empower our members and our coaching team every single day.




Key Responsibilities:

AI Product Development: Integrate state-of-the-art LLMs (e.g., OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude) into our core products.
Backend & API Engineering: Design, build, and maintain high-performance APIs to serve AI features to our frontend applications or clients.
LLMOps & Observability: Implement comprehensive monitoring for LLM usage, cost tracking, latency, and response quality.
Safety & Guardrails: Design and implement AI guardrails to prevent hallucinations, prompt injection, and ensure the model’s outputs align with business logic and safety standards.
System Architecture: Architect systems that handle AI context windows efficiently, utilizing databases, vector stores, and caching layers to minimize latency and API costs.
Deployment & DevOps: Containerize applications and deploy them securely to cloud environments, ensuring high availability and scalability.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python (the industry standard for AI/data). Experience with TypeScript/Node.js or Go is a strong plus for building high-concurrency backend services.
Backend Frameworks: Hands-on experience building RESTful APIs or GraphQL using frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or Express.js.
AI/LLM Ecosystem: Deep understanding of Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic workflows. Experience with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or building custom orchestration pipelines.
Experience with Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
Experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, or pgvector).
Strong knowledge of Caching mechanisms (Redis, Memcached) to optimize LLM API calls and reduce costs.
LLMOps & Observability: Experience using tools like Langfuse, LangSmith, Helicone, Portkey, or custom solutions to monitor token usage, latency, and AI behavior.
Cloud & Deployment: Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and deploying applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure.




Nice-to-Haves:

Data Engineering Basics: Familiarity with ETL pipelines and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) to help extract and clean the data used for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) or AI context.
Product & UX Sense: A strong understanding of user experience principles. Since you are building AI products, knowing how to handle AI latency (e.g., streaming text, loading states) to create a magical user experience is a huge plus.
Full-Stack / Frontend Familiarity: Basic experience with modern frontend frameworks (React, Vue.js, Streamlit, or Next.js) to quickly spin up prototypes, internal chat UIs, or admin dashboards for the AI products you build.




Why Join Us?

Impact: You aren't just optimizing click-through rates. The AI systems you build will directly support our psychologists, dietitians, and fitness coaches in helping members overcome chronic health challenges and improve their mental well-being.
Modern Tech Stack: Work with the latest and greatest in the AI ecosystem.
Brilliant & Kind Humans: You won’t just be working with sharp, low-ego engineers. You’ll be collaborating with clinical psychologists, medical doctors, and dietitians who are all deeply passionate about the same mission. We leave our egos at the door and support each other.
We encourage the use of our flexible vacation days policy! (just ensure your team isn't left in the lurch)




Perks

Flexible Paid Time-Off: We believe in work-life balance!
Medical Insurance: Your well-being is our priority.
Free use of our digital healthcare app, providing 24/7 access to medical experts.
Free therapy sessions: Mental health matters too!




Our People

We're a diverse group of Scuba Divers, Cooks, Travelers, and Enigmatologists (you might need to Google that!), Video Gamer heroes, Movie Buffs, Readers, Swimmers, Board Gamers, Music Lovers, every other variety of people. You'll find a friend in someone here!

Perform regression, smoke, and sanity testing as part of release cycles.
Ensure all game features are functioning as intended and meet design specifications.
Validate game balance, UI flow, and localization across regions.
Write clear and concise test cases, checklists, and QA documentation.
Provide feedback from the player's perspective to improve the overall game experience.

Provide detailed and actionable feedback on gameplay, UI/UX, and system behavior.

Fluent in Mandarin (both spoken and written), minimum HSK 4 or equivalent.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Game Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
Familiarity with bug-tracking and test management tools.
Basic understanding of game development processes and pipelines.
Familiarity with Unity engine and version control tools.
Ability to write and follow detailed test cases and report bugs clearly.

Experience with automated testing tools and scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript).
Knowledge of Unity, Unreal Engine, or other game engines.

Exposure to localization QA and multi-language testing.

A strategic role with real influence on FireRock’s growth, revenue, and community engagement across Indonesia and the broader SEA region.
A chance to shape how FireRock engages with Indonesia’s indie game ecosystem and connects with players and partners globally.
Close collaboration with a small, high-impact team where your network, insights, and execution matter.

title: Data Engineer
job_description:
About the job

At VIDA we’re building the future of digital identity. As a Data Engineer you’ll work across the stack—from platform and infrastructure to data pipelines and end-user tooling. You’ll help us modernize our batch ETLs and lead our push into streaming and real-time fraud detection . We run on AWS and make extensive use of Scala Spark, dbt, and Terraform.  Responsibilities 


 Build and expose the data lake/lakehouse so teams can understand business and product performance and make better decisions. 
 Design and evolve a data platform that enables scientists and analysts to query, model, and ship features and product metrics. 
 Develop scalable and reliable batch and streaming pipelines that ingest from varied sources and land trusted datasets. 
 Maintain and fix existing ETLs, improving reliability, observability, and cost while planning safe backfills and replays. 
 Model curated layers and maintain transformation logic (e.g., dbt ), including testing, documentation, and data quality. 
 Build with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform ) and contribute to CI/CD and deployment practices. 
 Partner with Engineering, and Data Science to deliver low-latency signals and features for real-time decisioning. 
 Contribute to internal tools, reusable components, and simple dashboards that unblock self-service. 


 Requirements 


 Solid engineering foundation with 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering and/or distributed systems. 
 Hands-on work building data pipelines (batch and/or streaming) using at least one distributed framework (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Flink ). 
 Comfortable with SQL and a transformation framework (e.g., dbt or similar). 
 Familiarity with AWS services for data (any mix of S3, EMR/Glue, Kinesis/MSK, Lambda, Redshift/Athena) or equivalent cloud experience. 
 Exposure to workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow). 
 Experience using Terraform (or similar IaC) to manage data/platform resources. 
 Ownership mindset, focus on reliability, and enjoyment of collaborating in a fast-moving environment. 


 What are we trying to solve? 

Billions of people still cannot securely prove their identity. Without it, they’re shut out of education, healthcare, finance, and civic participation. We believe this must change—and that digital identity should be trustworthy, private, and accessible to everyone.

At VIDA, we’re creating a frictionless digital identity system that meets the needs of our time and works anywhere, for everyone.

 Why are we solving this problem? 

Global initiatives like the UN and World Bank’s ID4D aim to provide legal identity for all by 2030 . We expect digital identity to become a basic right, and we want VIDA to help lead that future.

 Who are we? 

We’re a mission-driven, pragmatic team motivated by real-world impact—from preventing fraud and corruption to unlocking fair access to essential services. If that resonates with you, we’d love to talk.

This role

The Product lock analyst - Android security is responsible for testing and helping maintain PayJoy's proprietary device locking technology against various bypass methods and tools, after every OS Over-The-Air (OTA) update, any update to our lock technology itself and any update to the in-market tools.

Responsibilities


Proactively and systematically test PayJoy's device locking mechanism on a diverse range of Android devices and OS versions following every OTA update.
Conduct thorough, periodic testing of the lock after every update or modification to the PayJoy lock technology. 
Actively research, identify, acquire, and utilize existing and emerging lock-breaking tools, software, hardware techniques, and methodologies (e.g., factory reset exploits, bootloader vulnerabilities, ADB exploits, custom ROM flashing, FRP bypass tools) to attempt to bypass the PayJoy lock.
Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios specifically focused on lock security, bypass attempts, and anti-tampering features.
Simulate various attack vectors and user behaviors that could lead to a lock bypass.
Document all testing activities, methodologies, findings, discovered vulnerabilities, and precise steps to reproduce in a clear, concise, and actionable manner using our bug tracking system (e.g., JIRA).

About the job

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Position Overview

The Data Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and operating a cloud-native data platform built on Snowflake and public cloud infrastructure. This role owns the full lifecycle of the data platform — from cloud environment provisioning and data lake architecture to transformation pipelines, security enforcement, and data sharing — enabling reliable, governed, and scalable data access across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Provision and manage cloud environments including storage, networking, and IAM across public cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure). 
Architect and administer Snowflake as the organization's unified Data Lake and Data Warehouse platform. 
Define and enforce Data Access Policies with encryption, IAM, and Snowflake network policies. 
Build and maintain dbt transformation models with Git-based version control across staging and production data layers. 
Define platform standards, and best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and consumption layers. 


Required Skills & Experience


Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), covering storage, networking, and IAM. 
Strong Snowflake administration skills including RBAC design, Data Sharing, external tables, and Snowpark. 
Proficiency in dbt (Core or Cloud) for model development, testing, and documentation. 
Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tooling such as Terraform for cloud resource provisioning. 
Experience with pipeline orchestration using Snowflake Scheduling, Apache Airflow, or equivalent tools. 


Scope of Ownership


Responsible for the end-to-end design, provisioning, and operation of the cloud data platform — spanning raw ingestion zones through to curated, analytics-ready data layers — ensuring reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency across all environments. 
Maintains overall responsibility for the unified data warehouse and lake platform architecture, including performance tuning, resource management, cost governance, and the evolution of the platform as organizational data needs grow. 
Owns the transformation layer from design through to production, ensuring data models, testing frameworks, and documentation are accurate, consistent, and fit for consumption across all downstream use cases. 
Drives the definition and adoption of platform-wide standards covering data ingestion, transformation, and consumption patterns, and evaluates tooling and architectural decisions as the platform matures.

About the job



About US

Hubexo provides cutting-edge data, insights, and software solutions to the global construction industry. Founded in Sweden in 1936, Hubexo specializes in project information, eTendering, product information, market intelligence, and specification.
 With operations in more than 20 countries and a workforce of 2,500 employees, Hubexo helps its customers sell more efficiently, build sustainably, and lead the future of construction innovation. 

About the Role

Olmero is Hubexo’s SaaS platform serving the Swiss construction industry. We’re building a new Jakarta-based team to work closely with our colleagues in Switzerland, and we’re looking for a Software Tester to be the first dedicated tester for Olmero in the hub.

Until now, most manual testing has been done directly by Product Owners. With the new team, we want someone who will take real ownership of testing: bringing structure to manual tests, helping reduce regressions, and gradually shaping how we approach test automation together with the engineers.

If you enjoy digging into web applications, thinking like a user, and quietly raising the quality bar every day, this might be a good place for you.

 

Key Responsibilities

 
Own and perform manual testing on Olmero’s test environment for new features and changes.
Review user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira, ask clarifying questions, and ensure they are clear and testable.
Design and maintain test cases, test scenarios, and checklists for functional, regression, and smoke testing.
Perform exploratory testing to uncover edge cases and usability issues.
Identify, document, and track defects clearly in Jira, and follow up with developers on resolutions.
Prepare and share concise test reports and release-readiness notes with the team.
Collaborate closely with developers, Product Owner, and Tech Leads (Switzerland and Jakarta) to understand flows, risks, and priorities.
Contribute to building a more structured testing and release process, including basic integration testing over time.
Gradually help the team identify high-value candidates for automation and support early automation initiatives where relevant.
 

 

Qualifications

Human Skills

 
Growth mindset: Demonstrated willingness to learn, adapt, and improve ways of working.
Empathy: Ability to understand user perspectives and the impact of defects on customers and teammates.
Communication: Clear verbal and written communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English; able to explain findings and risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Team collaboration: Proven experience working in cross-functional teams (developers, POs, designers, etc.).
Ownership: Comfortable taking responsibility as the first dedicated tester on a product and following issues through to completion.
Adaptability: Able to work with evolving requirements and priorities in a distributed team setup.
 

Technical Skills

 
5+ years of experience as a Software Tester / QA Engineer, preferably on web-based SaaS products.
Strong experience in manual testing: functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing.
Ability to create clear, well-structured test cases and scenarios based on requirements and specifications.

Familiarity with testing against acceptance criteria and working closely with Product Managers.
Familiarity with Test Case Management tools such as AIO Tests, Qase, TestRail, or similar platforms.
Basic understanding of web technologies (HTTP, APIs, browsers, common failure modes).
 

 

Nice to Have

 
Basic proficiency with Git for source control.
Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
Experience or interest in integration testing and end-to-end testing.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests fit into them.
Experience working with distributed teams across time zones.
 

 

Education and Experience

 
Experience in a SaaS environment or other complex, business-critical systems.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience is also welcome.

‍enabling entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience

As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.

Empowering Private Markets: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets.

Innovative Financial Ecosystem: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services.

As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally.

Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Alta, you will have the opportunity to leverage your extensive full-stack software skills in a modern and rapidly evolving development environment, while also being deeply integrated into a broader team that’s on the leading edge of financial innovation. Blockchain, DeFi, API/service-driven architectures, serverless infrastructure, data pipelines, front-end frameworks and no-code platforms are all key elements of our technological ecosystem that you will be exposed to.

‍

At Alta, we are developing a suite of platforms and services that form the backbone of our operations. Brokerage: A rich and evolving web experience designed to cater to diverse investors, focusing on alternative assets across all classes through insightful, data-driven dashboards and deep asset analysis. Back-Office Operations Platform: A robust platform that integrates with numerous third-party service providers in KYC, payments, and settlement, along with ready integration with our internal systems to streamline operations across various departments. Exchange: A modern, digital-first asset exchange aimed at rapid API-driven trades, providing member firms with readily accessible market data through API integrations or direct UI access. Custody: An adaptable and scalable approach to digital asset tokenization, offering agnostic support across various asset classes and blockchains, coupled with a hybrid ledger for seamless custodial operations. As a Senior Engineer, you will play a crucial role in building and shaping these applications.

We’re a supportive, social, and entrepreneurial team of former investment bankers, technologists and strategists. Clear, honest communication is key to everything we do.

Keeping up to date with the latest in tooling and industry best practice, ensuring that we’re constantly discussing, evaluating and implementing the best
Expressing your ideas, opinions and feedback on our tech stack, tooling and culture to ensure we’re always improving as a technology team and as a company

Food! We talk about it a lot :)

title: Data Engineer
job_description:
About the job

About BTSE

BTSE Group is a global leader in fintech and blockchain technology, anchored by three core business pillars: Exchange, Payments, and Infrastructure Development. Serving over 100 corporate clients worldwide, we provide white-label exchange and payment solutions. Our offerings encompass everything from exchange infrastructure hosting and development to custody, wallets, payments, blockchain integration, trading, and more. We are looking for talented professionals in marketing, operations, customer support, and other departments. The roles offered may be on-site, remote, or hybrid, in collaboration with our local partner.

About The Opportunity

We're building an AI-powered research platform for institutional investors. Our platform turns vast amounts of market, alternative, and proprietary data into actionable intelligence — powered by AI agents that depend on clean, reliable, real-time data to do their job.

We need someone to own data. Not manage a team that does data. Own it — from finding the right sources, to getting them flowing, to making sure they stay healthy at scale.

Today we ingest from hundreds of sources. That number is growing fast. The sources are diverse: real-time market feeds, regulatory filings, on-chain blockchain data, news, social sentiment, alternative datasets, and proprietary client data. Some are free APIs. Some are $10K/month enterprise contracts. Some are clients pushing their own data into our platform. Every one of them is different, and most of them will break in ways you don't expect.

You'll evaluate vendors, negotiate deals, build integrations, monitor quality, track costs, and make the call on what's worth paying for. When something breaks at 2 AM, you'll know why before the alert finishes firing.

This is an end-to-end ownership role. No handoffs.

Responsibilities


Build and maintain integrations with a large and growing number of external data sources — APIs, WebSockets, file drops, streams, scrapers, and formats you haven't seen yet
Evaluate and compare data vendors across quality, reliability, coverage, cost, and terms of service
Negotiate contracts and manage commercial relationships with data providers
Design and operate high-throughput ingestion pipelines handling mixed workloads (real-time, near-real-time, batch, event-driven)
Build monitoring that tells you — before anyone else — when data is late, wrong, incomplete, or drifting
Manage data quality at scale: anomaly detection, cross-source validation, schema drift detection, gap filling
Handle both structured data (time-series, tabular) and unstructured data (documents, text, images) with appropriate extraction and storage
Track costs per source, usage per consumer, and ROI — recommend what to keep, upgrade, or cancel
Build tooling that makes adding the next data source faster than the last one
Use AI tools aggressively in your daily work — for code generation, testing, documentation, anomaly analysis, and anything else that makes you faster


Requirements

**You've done this before:**


 5+ years building data pipelines that run in production, 24/7, with real SLAs
 Deep hands-on experience with SQL databases and time-series data
 Python as your primary language, comfortable with async programming
 You've integrated with dozens of external APIs and dealt with the reality of unreliable vendors, changing schemas, rate limits, and bad documentation
 You've built monitoring and alerting for data systems — not as an afterthought but as part of how you work


You Think About The Whole Picture


 You don't just connect to an API. You think about what happens when it goes down, when the schema changes, when the data is wrong, when the bill doubles
 You understand that data has a cost and a value, and not every source is worth keeping
 You've worked with data vendors commercially — contracts, pricing tiers, usage negotiations


You Use AI Daily


 AI coding tools are part of your workflow today, not something you're curious about
 You can articulate specifically how AI makes you faster and where it doesn't help
 You'd be frustrated if you couldn't use AI in your work


Nice to have


Experience with financial or crypto market data
Experience with streaming systems (Kafka or similar) at scale
Vector database or embedding pipeline experience
Experience with unstructured data extraction (PDFs, documents, NLP)


Perks & Benefits


Senior individual contributor role with full ownership of the data domain
Direct access to leadership — no bureaucracy, fast decisions
AI tools provided and encouraged across all work
Remote-friendly, async-first
Compensation commensurate with experience

About the job

Role Description

We're looking for a Junior IT Programmer - CoE based in Jakarta, Indonesia; full-time, on-site. You'll be hands-on from day one: building, maintaining, and integrating systems that actually get used. This isn't a support ticket role. You'll work alongside a project owners, coordinate with stakeholders, and own your deliverables end to end. Monkeybar Digital operates on execution, and we expect the same from everyone on the team.




About the Center of Excellence (CoE)

The CoE is the internal engine that keeps the broader organization sharp. We exist to support other business units - diagnosing their technology gaps, building solutions, and making sure those solutions actually land. But we don't just fix and move on. We introduce new methods, tools, and ways of working, then transfer that knowledge so teams can carry it forward independently. 




What You'll Do

Write, maintain, and debug code across applications and system integrations.
Turn functional specs into working implementations alongside the Business Analyst.
Connect and monitor systems: APIs, databases, third-party platforms, and own issues through to resolution.
Support business units directly: build for their needs, document so they can learn.
See work through testing, QA, and deployment without hand-holding.




Qualifications

Fresh graduate or early-career - we hire on capability, not tenure.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
Solid grasp of at least one backend language (PHP, Python, Node.js, or Java) plus working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Comfortable with REST APIs, JSON, and basic integration patterns.
Can write SQL without Googling every line.
Communicates clearly in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.
Takes ownership - you don't wait to be followed up.




Strong Plus

Hands-on experience with Git and deployment workflows.
Prior work involving API or third-party integrations.
Internship or project experience in a professional or client-facing environment.




Why This Role

Your code runs in production. Real systems, real stakes.
You'll sit inside a CoE - exposed to multiple business units, problems, and domains from day one.
You'll sit close to decision-making: technical and business, earlier than most junior roles allow.
A team that measures output, not effort. If you deliver, it shows.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Clear room to grow as you earn it.




Company Description

Monkeybar Digital is a digital transformation studio built by practitioners - engineers, strategists, and implementers who've been in the trenches of real system deployments across Indonesia and Singapore. We don't deliver strategy decks and disappear; we stay engaged through implementation because we're invested in outcomes.

title: Senior QA Engineer (Enterprise Efficiency) - Sea Labs
job_description:
About the job

About the Team:

About Sea Labs Indonesia

Sea Labs is at the core of the Sea platforms development, supporting diverse business lines from e-commerce, supply chain, games, payment and finance, among many others. The strong growth and unique positioning of Sea's e-commerce business, Shopee, spurred the launch of Sea Labs Indonesia. Since its inception, the group of passionate engineers have charted the course to drive the best experience for our users in Indonesia, many of which solutions are even adapted to other markets in the region.

Sea's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience world-class projects first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do. Together with our passionate and driven teams, you'll get to develop your skills, build on industry knowledge and collaborate with global teams in a dynamic space. Browse our Sea Labs Indonesia team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.

About Team

The Enterprise Efficiency team is dedicated to transforming workplace productivity through seamless integration of enterprise communication, open platform capabilities, and management systems covering HR, finance, and operational tools. Our products power the daily workflows of thousands of employees across Sea group companies.

Our product lines include SeaTalk (enterprise communication and collaboration platform) and PFMS (People and Financial Management System). We are currently driving enterprise initiatives where we actively leverage AI-powered tools and LLM integrations to enhance product capabilities and accelerate engineering workflows.

Job Description:


Design and implement the test automation strategy across API, integration, and E2E layers for both SeaTalk and PFMS product lines.
Build and maintain CI/CD-integrated test pipelines that gate releases and run on every merge request.
Establish test environment management practices including reliable provisioning, data seeding, and environment parity with production.
Define and instrument QA-relevant observability: structured test execution logs, flakiness tracking, coverage dashboards, and failure triage workflows.
Evaluate and select test frameworks and tooling; own the technical decisions on what we use and how we use it.
Own the regression testing strategy: define scope, maintain suites, and ensure regression cycles do not become release bottlenecks.
Act as the quality gate authority for production releases — define go/no-go criteria and enforce them consistently.
Drive test case design standards ensuring coverage aligns with PRD requirements and technical risk areas, not just happy paths.
Serve as the technical quality authority: set standards, conduct test design reviews, and coach QA engineers on automation skills and engineering best practices.
Collaborate with backend and frontend leads on testability improvements — advocate for contract testing, structured logging, and API design that supports automated verification.
Coordinate QA efforts across cross-site teams (Singapore, Shenzhen) during multi-team releases.
Participate in technical design reviews to identify test strategy early in the development lifecycle.
Communicate quality risks, test coverage gaps, and trade-offs clearly to product managers and engineering leadership.



Requirements:


5+ years of experience in software QA/quality engineering, with at least 3 years focused on test automation architecture and infrastructure.
Deep hands-on experience with at least two of: Selenium/WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress (E2E); pytest, JUnit, TestNG (API/unit); or equivalent frameworks.
Proven track record of building CI/CD-integrated test pipelines from scratch or significantly improving existing ones (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar).
Strong programming skills in at least one of: Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript — writes production-quality test code, not scripts.
Experience with API testing at scale: REST, contract testing, and service-level integration verification.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction without direct management authority — influences through expertise, standards, and results.
Experience working in cross-functional teams with frontend, backend, and product stakeholders.
Proficient in using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate testing, debugging, and documentation workflows.
General AI literacy — understands core AI/LLM concepts and can evaluate where AI capabilities can be practically applied to improve QA processes.
Clear, proactive communication style — surfaces risks early, documents decisions, and keeps stakeholders informed without being asked.
Comfortable working across time zones with distributed teams.

About The Role

As a SDET Lead at Liven, you will play a hands-on technical leadership role in shaping our quality engineering practices and automation strategy. You’ll architect and develop testing frameworks, guide engineering teams on testability, and ensure our backend services—built in Express.js (Node.js) and Go—are reliable and scalable. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong ownership, and the ability to lead both by example and through influence across teams.

What You'll Do


Lead and contribute hands-on to the design, development, and evolution of testing architecture and automation frameworks.
Architect and implement high-quality automated test suites (unit, integration, contract, and E2E) for Node.js/Express and Go services.
Ensure automated tests are efficiently integrated and executed within CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborate with engineers to embed testability into system design and promote high-quality code practices.
Drive exploratory testing and guide advanced testing efforts for complex, distributed systems.
Define quality standards, testing strategies, and metrics across engineering teams.

Our mission is to create innovative, robust, and user-friendly digital identity solutions. We are looking for a passionate and skilled Deep Learning AI Scientist specializing in Liveness Detection and Biometrics to join our dynamic team. Your work will directly impact the security and reliability of VIDA's identity verification systems.

 Liveness Detection Development: Design, train, and deploy advanced deep learning models to ensure robust liveness detection, preventing spoofing attacks using photos, videos, masks, or other methods. 
 Design, train and deploy biometric models to correctly identify users 
 Own the full lifecycle of deploying models: from data labelling, working with engineers to design scalable APIs, to monitoring and A/B testing new model versions 
 Stay updated with the latest research in biometrics, computer vision, and deep learning, incorporating new techniques to improve VIDA’s products 
 Collaborate with business, product, operations and engineering teams to deliver impact for our customers

 Proficient in Python, C++, Scala, or Java

We have 7.5 billion people on Earth, of which over 1 billion cannot securely prove their identity right now.

Why are we solving this problem?

The United Nations (UN) and World Bank ID4D initiatives aim to provide everyone on the planet with a legal identity by 2030. This deadline is just 9 years away, we are expecting a digital identity to be a legal human right by then and we at VIDA want to be pioneers in leading this change.

About FINN

FINN is a fintech company building simple and transparent products that improve financial well-being for underbanked employees. Our core offering gives people access to wages they have already earned, alongside tools to help them manage money better, build savings, access insurance, earn additional income, and use fairer financial services.

Founded in 2022, FINN is the largest player in the early wage access space in Southeast Asia and is expanding rapidly into new markets globally. We are looking for ambitious builders who take ownership, move fast, and want to shape products that create meaningful impact in people’s lives.

We're looking for a Data Engineer to own the data modeling, pipeline development, and analytics layer that powers decision-making across every department at FINN. This is a high-impact, foundational hire — you'll be one of the first dedicated data team members, working alongside our Data Platform Engineer who builds the infrastructure you'll operate on.

This role starts as a combined Data Engineer + Data Analyst position. You'll build the pipelines and deliver the insights. As FINN scales from 3–4 markets to 10–12 and the data team grows, this role will specialize into a dedicated Data Engineering function with separate Data Analysts joining the team.

You'll report to the CTO and work closely with department data owners across Product, Operations, Credit Risk, and Finance to turn raw data into reliable, well-modeled datasets and actionable dashboards.

Responsibilities

Immediate Priorities (Year 1)


Build and maintain data models in dbt, establishing naming conventions, documentation standards, and testing patterns
Define and implement core business metrics in collaboration with department data owners (Product, Operations, Finance, Credit Risk)
Create and maintain dashboards and reports that drive operational and strategic decisions
Design and build data pipelines for ingesting data from internal services and external sources into BigQuery
Establish data quality checks and monitoring to ensure reliability of key metrics
Partner with the Data Platform Engineer to shape the data infrastructure roadmap from an end-user perspective


Scaling & Ownership (Year 2)


Own the full data model layer — dimensional models, staging tables, and marts — with clear documentation and lineage
Build self-service datasets that enable non-technical stakeholders to answer their own questions
Develop automated pipelines for recurring cross-department data requests (replacing ad-hoc queries)
Collaborate with the Credit Risk team on portfolio analytics, scoring model data, and regulatory reporting data needs
Implement data governance practices: ownership metadata, freshness SLAs, and access controls in coordination with the Data Platform Engineer
Drive adoption of metric definitions and a single source of truth across departments


Team Growth & Specialization (Year 2+)


Mentor incoming Data Analysts as the team expands, establishing engineering best practices for the analytics layer
Transition analytical workload to dedicated Data Analysts while focusing on complex data engineering challenges
Lead the design of new data products — real-time dashboards, predictive model feature stores, and embedded analytics
Contribute to FINN's data mesh evolution by owning domain-specific data products


Technical Requirements

Must Have


2+ years of professional experience in data engineering or analytics engineering
Strong SQL — you can write complex queries, optimize performance, and design efficient data models
Python proficiency for data pipeline development, scripting, and automation
Experience with BigQuery or an equivalent cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift)
Hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
Working knowledge of dbt (or demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly — we're actively building our dbt layer)
Experience with dashboard and visualization tools (Looker, Metabase, or similar)
Solid understanding of data modeling — dimensional design, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions


Nice to Have


FinTech or regulated industry experience (lending, payments, insurance)
Exposure to credit risk data, portfolio analytics, or financial reporting
Familiarity with Terraform or Infrastructure as Code
Experience with streaming data or real-time pipelines (Pub/Sub, Kafka, Dataflow)
Experience working in a startup scaling from early stage to multi-market operations


What Makes You Successful


Ownership Mindset: You don't wait for tickets — you identify what the business needs and build it. At FINN, we operate in "hard mode" and everyone owns outcomes, not just tasks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: You're comfortable sitting with a Finance lead or a Product Manager to understand their data needs and translating that into well-modeled, tested datasets.
Rigor and Attention to Detail: Bad data is worse than no data. You care deeply about data quality, testing, and documentation.
Tenacity and Drive: We're scaling to $100M ARR by 2028 across 10–12 markets. This is fast-paced, ambiguous, and demanding — you thrive in that environment.
Communication: You can explain data models and metric definitions to non-technical stakeholders clearly and patiently.
Builder Energy: You're excited about creating something from scratch, not maintaining a legacy system. You'll be defining how FINN thinks about data.
Remote Work: You love working remotely #APJ #EMEA


Our Stack


Data Warehouse: GCP BigQuery
Transformation: dbt
Backend: AWS services
Languages: Python, SQL
IaC: Terraform
Dashboards: Looker (evolving)
Orchestration: To be determined (in collaboration with Data/Platform Team)
Methodology: Agile/Scrum — 2-week sprints


Relationship to Data Platform Engineer

At scale this role will work in close partnership with the Data Platform Engineering Team (to be built out) who will build and maintain the underlying data infrastructure (BigQuery configuration, Terraform, orchestration, data mesh architecture). As a Data Engineer, you operate on that platform — building the models, pipelines, metrics, and dashboards that deliver value to the business. Write highly optimized SQL and manage database performance — query tuning, indexing strategies, and ensuring our data infrastructure scales as transaction volume grows.

Build dashboards and reporting tools that give our data science team and business stakeholders clear visibility into transaction flows, platform health, and key business metrics.
Design and maintain feature pipelines and training data infrastructure to support ML models powering intelligent product features such as fraud signals, FX recommendations, and payment routing optimization.

Experience with at least one modern data warehouse and a transformation tool (Snowflake / BigQuery / Redshift).
You've built and operated ETL/ELT pipelines end-to-end — ingestion, transformation, testing, and monitoring.
A software engineering mindset: you write code that others can maintain, you think in systems, and you care about correctness.

Nice-to-haves

Experience in fintech, payments, or any domain with high-volume transactional data.
Experience with real-time or streaming data processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink, Spark Streaming)
Familiarity with ML data concepts: feature stores, training pipelines, dataset versioning.
Cloud infrastructure exposure — AWS or GCP.
Experience with a BI/analytics layer (Looker, Metabase, Mode, Sigma, or similar).
